answer.reason: JDG 3:31 states Shamgar's deed and his deliverance of Israel; JDG 5:6 only dates a time of unsafe roads and adds no deed.

clauses.english: slew six hundred Philistines with an ox goad and delivered Israel
clauses.quote: slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad

doubts: JDG 5:6 only names the days of Shamgar as a time when highways were unoccupied; it states no deed of his, so it is left out.
